card.title: When the Leak Returns
card.situation: A tenant reports a recurring ceiling leak to a building manager while an upstairs neighbor joins the conversation; they coordinate an inspection without presuming the cause.
card.description: Raise a repeated problem, acknowledge uncertainty, and arrange a clear next update.
card.scene: Apartment hallway with a damp ceiling stain visible through the tenant's open doorway; tenant, building manager, and upstairs neighbor speak calmly.
card.learnerInput: An observable damp ceiling patch; eight concise Korean turns with differing interests and a polite shift from concern to coordination.
card.expectedOutput: Report the evidence, distinguish observation from blame, and request a concrete communication plan after inspection.
card.relationshipAndRegister: Tenant, building manager, and upstairs neighbor are unfamiliar adults; consistent polite 해요체, with the manager a touch more procedural.
card.targetConstruction: Repeated event + qualified inference + practical request; mitigate disagreement without abandoning urgency.
card.retainedCore: All speakers address the same recurring water damage and the immediate inspection sequence.
card.variationOpportunity: Change the damaged item from a bookshelf to a desk and request a written update rather than an oral one.
card.independentProductionPrompt: Without seeing the model, report the newly wet desk, avoid assigning blame, and ask the manager to send the inspection result in a message.

speakerRoles.voiceCharacter: Concerned, precise, and careful not to accuse
Calm, accountable for coordination, but careful about an unverified cause
Slightly defensive at first, then cooperative
speakerRoles.castingNote: Distinct Standard Korean male voice selected from the connected ElevenLabs library on 2026-10-27; not the manager's Min-joon voice.

lines.speaker: eunji
lines.ko: 지난번에 물 샜던 천장에 또 물자국이 생겼어요. 이번엔 책장 뒤까지 젖었고요.
lines.en: There's another water stain on the ceiling that leaked before. This time even the back of my bookshelf got wet.

lines.speaker: taesik
lines.ko: 같은 자리군요. 위층에서 새는 건지 배관 쪽인지부터 확인해야겠어요.
lines.en: It's the same spot. We'll first need to check whether it's coming from upstairs or from the pipes.

lines.speaker: junseok
lines.ko: 저희 집에서는 새는 게 안 보였는데, 필요하면 점검은 받겠습니다.
lines.en: I haven't seen a leak in my place, but I'm willing to have it inspected if needed.

lines.speaker: eunji
lines.ko: 원인을 단정하려는 건 아니에요. 다만 또 젖기 전에 임시 조치가 가능한지 궁금해서요.
lines.en: I'm not trying to jump to conclusions about the cause. I'm just wondering if there's a temporary measure before it gets wet again.

lines.speaker: taesik
lines.ko: 현장을 봐야 어떤 조치가 가능한지 말씀드릴 수 있어요. 사진하고 언제 발견하셨는지 먼저 보내 주시겠어요?
lines.en: I need to see the site before I can say what can be done. Could you send me photos and when you first noticed it?

lines.speaker: junseok
lines.ko: 내일 오후엔 집에 있으니, 점검 시간이 정해지면 알려 주세요.
lines.en: I'll be home tomorrow afternoon, so let me know when the inspection is scheduled.

lines.speaker: eunji
lines.ko: 사진 보내겠습니다. 확인한 내용과 수리 일정도 같이 공유 부탁드려요.
lines.en: I'll send the photos. Please share what you find and the repair schedule as well.

lines.speaker: taesik
lines.ko: 네, 확인되는 대로 두 분께 같은 내용으로 안내드릴게요.
lines.en: Of course. As soon as we know more, I'll give both of you the same update.

variationPrompt.en: Your desk is now wet too. Report it without blaming the upstairs neighbor and ask for the inspection result by message.
variationPrompt.ko: 이번에는 책상도 젖었어요. 윗집을 탓하지 않으면서 상황을 설명하고, 점검 결과를 문자로 알려 달라고 말해 보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: 이번엔 책상도 젖었어요. 원인을 단정하려는 건 아니고요. 점검 결과가 나오면 문자로 알려 주실 수 있을까요?

card.artworkBrief: Warm, realistic apartment corridor and partly open doorway with a subtle wet ceiling stain. One woman tenant, male building manager, and male upstairs neighbor in a calm conversation; no dramatic flood, text, or logos.
